name: Particle Hero
tagline: A hero made of half a million particles that gather into each of your subjects in turn and part like smoke under the cursor.
youSay: /particle-hero A hero for our sneaker range where each model turns into the next
whatYouGet: A hero where each subject (a product, an animal, a portrait, an object) is rebuilt from up to half a million grains with real depth, and the grains swarm or melt from one subject into the next
A hover that feels natural: the whole subject turns toward the cursor in 3D, and the cursor carries the grains along like a hand through smoke before they drift home on their own
Four looks to start from: bone-white dust on black with trackers and wind, coloured ink on cream paper, neon dust with lights flashing on a beat, or a light one-colour print with callouts
The whole page with its own type and words, a list to pick a subject, one call to action and a phone layout, checked headless on desktop and phone, as a static site you can host anywhere
goodFit: Product ranges and collections (shoes, bottles, chairs, gadgets), museums and exhibitions, festivals and lineups, perfume, beauty and luxury brands
Heroes that should show several subjects in one striking, interactive moment
notFor: Pages that must show a product photo exactly: the subject is drawn in grains, not shown as a photo
youBring: What the page is for, three to five subjects and what visitors should do
Optional: your own product photos or portraits, and the brand's name, colours and tone
needs: Skillsmart credits: about 88 for a four-subject page
Optional: Chrome or Edge, for the headless check

generates.estimate: about 22 a subject: 20 for the picture, 2 for the cut-out (your own photo: 2)
